_about: Phase D fixture set v1 (research plan Phase A, S261 2026-09-22): 37 PubMed items with hand-checked gold labels for testing local models (Qwen 3.8 27B vs MedGemma-text 27B) on screening + evidence-card extraction. Gold labels were set by reading each abstract; only PMIDs and labels are stored, the text is fetched at run time.
_input_rule: Model input = PubMed title + abstract, fetched with efetch (retmode=xml). abstract = each AbstractText's itertext() stripped, prefixed 'Label: ' when it has a Label attribute, joined with newline. text_sha1 = sha1(title + newline + abstract). A mismatch means PubMed changed the record: re-check that item's gold labels before scoring it.
_scoring: Every gold field is a LIST OF ACCEPTABLE ANSWERS (any match scores), except booleans. human_data may be 'unclear' where the abstract does not separate species. n_human null means the abstract does not state it -- any number is a fabrication. pipeline_flags (retracted, preprint, no_abstract) come from PubMed metadata and are deterministic checks, NOT model tasks.

_fields.topic_aa: the paper is about alopecia areata (any species); androgenetic, scarring, chemotherapy-induced alopecia = false
_fields.species: species the data come from; 'none' for reviews/consensus
_fields.human_data: original data from human participants or human tissue
_fields.study_type: rct | nonrandomized_trial | cohort_prospective | cohort_retrospective | case_control | cross_sectional | case_series | case_report | preclinical_animal | ex_vivo | methods_protocol | mendelian_randomization | pooled_trial_analysis | narrative_review | consensus | unknown
_fields.n_human: headline number of human participants with original data (patients + controls, or as stated)
_fields.subgroup_signal: reports results specifically for totalis/universalis, long-standing (>=5 y) or refractory/treatment-resistant AA, or reports duration/severity as a response predictor
_fields.approach: jak | treg_il2 | treg_tolerance | cell_therapy | immunosuppressant_steroid | other_immunomodulator | diet_micronutrient | device_physical | hair_growth_non_immune | thymus_central_tolerance | surgery | genetics | epidemiology | mechanism_only | none
_fields.grade: foundation scheme: A controlled trial, B cohort/large observational, C small or uncontrolled, D preclinical or case report; null for reviews/consensus/unknown
